payload.interpretation: sentence:512 is separable from 0 of 14 other configs after Holm correction at alpha = 0.05.

metrics.note: Truthfulness: mean CRAG judge score in {-1,0,+1} (PRD 10.3). Headline metric.
metrics.floor_note: 5 discordant pairs (25 ties) bound the two-sided p at 2/2**5 = 0.0625, above alpha = 0.05: no effect size could reach significance at this discordance count. 6 discordant pairs would be needed.

metrics.note: Supported statements / total, against the retrieved context (PRD 10.2). NULL for abstentions and for answers that decompose to zero statements, so it has fewer complete pairs than the other metrics.
metrics.floor_note: 5 discordant pairs (21 ties) bound the two-sided p at 2/2**5 = 0.0625, above alpha = 0.05: no effect size could reach significance at this discordance count. 6 discordant pairs would be needed.

metrics.note: Cosine between embeddings of the generated and the expected answer (PRD 10.5). Both sides use the document prefix: this is an answer-vs-answer comparison, not query-vs-document. Phase 1's own analysis found Spearman rho (cosine_sim, crag_score) = -0.001 across the 15 configurations -- no monotonic relationship to answer quality -- so it is reportable here as a descriptive statistic and not as a proxy for the judge.
metrics.floor_note: 28 discordant pairs (2 ties) bound the two-sided p at 2/2**28 = 7.45058e-09, at or below alpha = 0.05.

metrics.note: SQuAD token-overlap F1. Rewards terse answers, so it does not track Truthfulness here — reported because a metric that disagrees is evidence, not noise.
metrics.floor_note: 27 discordant pairs (3 ties) bound the two-sided p at 2/2**27 = 1.49012e-08, at or below alpha = 0.05.

metrics.note: SQuAD exact match. Same terseness caveat as squad_f1.
metrics.floor_note: 1 discordant pair (29 ties) bound the two-sided p at 2/2**1 = 1, above alpha = 0.05: no effect size could reach significance at this discordance count. 6 discordant pairs would be needed.

paired.direction: claude-opus-4-8 minus llama3.1:8b; in `wilcoxon`, wins = claude-opus-4-8 ahead
paired.permutation: seeded Monte Carlo above 20 pairs, exhaustive at or below (PRD 11)
paired.interpretation: claude-opus-4-8 is separable from llama3.1:8b on 0 of 5 tested metrics after Holm correction at alpha = 0.05, though for any metric whose permutation floor (see floor_note) already exceeds alpha, Holm correction was not the binding constraint.
paired.floor_note_explanation: the tie count does not affect the floor because a sign-flip permutation is invariant under flipping a zero difference, so only the discordant-pair count sets the smallest attainable two-sided p

abstention.detector_caveat: the predicate matches only the exact phrase, ignoring case, smart quotes and trailing sentence punctuation. A verbose refusal is counted as a non-abstention, so recall is a lower bound — see missed_question_ids
